contract.after: Literal tab splitting requires exactly four nonempty fields. contract.history: Matching qualified manager records keep the same exact version/architecture half-installed incoming boundary. External preflight refuses manager history. Valid prior-version conflict fixtures require migration refusal, not an earlier malformed-row result.
contract.preservation: Both unpack guards still read only. Configure/repeat/abort remain native check-only, never initialize on absence/failure. Removal preserves source state, upgrade refuses, release gate and prepared-image migration policy unchanged.
contract.scope: These observations permit unpack only and never establish pristine history, first authority, a source license or runtime grant.
contract.limits: Not full Debian version semantics, an atomic inventory lease, cancellation/byte bound on query, or detection of successful omitted/truncated output. Command substitution strips trailing newlines; trailing blank rows/newline-only output are indistinguishable from a zero-record observation. Interior blanks refuse. No firmware-row requirement.
